text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was on the day of the Arima Kinen—
right after sending Narita Taishin off to the pre-race weigh-in.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Knock knock...)

Um, excuse me. ...Are you
Narita Taishin's Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Taishin's Mother
text_block_list.text: ...Nice to meet you, I'm Taishin's mother.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Now that I looked closely, the adult Umamusume who bore an uncanny resemblance to her
bowed deeply, paying no mind to my surprise.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And then, I spoke briefly
with Narita Taishin's mother."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While the girls running in races were almost all born in spring,
Narita Taishin was born very late, and perhaps because of that, her body was small.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "That is precisely why I was so worried she would get severely injured in a race that I couldn't properly cheer for her."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Even so, when Narita Taishin still wanted to run, I apologized for giving birth to her so small—and made her terribly angry...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And Narita Taishin's mother handed me a bouquet of flowers,
saying, "Please give this to my daughter."

text_block_list.name: Taishin's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"I'm sure she wouldn't accept it easily,
so please don't tell her it's from me."

text_block_list.name: Taishin's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"Still, if nothing else... just for today, just for this race,
I truly wanted to cheer her on with all my heart."

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I'm back.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Hm? A bouquet?
choice_data_list: I-It's from a fan! It says 'Do your best!'
I-It's from a fan! It says 'You can do it!'

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Hmmmmmm...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"...Are you making fun of me?
You, and... Mom too."

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I told you before that my family runs our own business, right?
We own a flower shop.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Sheesh... One look at how it's wrapped and anyone can tell.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Well, but... whether Mom's watching
or not, it doesn't matter anyway.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I just run for my own sake.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...I'll just run and win. That's all.
